title: Write alpha release evidence runbook
summary: Alpha releases need a repeatable runbook that explains what evidence is generated, where it lands, and how to validate it. Document the end-to-end flow using the existing alpha release evidence script without implying public signing or publication policy.
expectedFailureModes: Release evidence exists but operators cannot reproduce it without reverse-engineering scripts.
Docs overclaim public verifiability or signing before key custody and publication are decided.
Evidence artifacts are generated but not checked into the release bundle, leaving the release unverifiable later.
humanEscalation: Human decision remains required for any public signing keys, key rotation, and release publication.
nextAction: Document the alpha release evidence workflow: prerequisites, commands, output locations, and how to interpret evidence, leaving signing/publishing as explicitly human-owned.
